description: Hold TypeScript at 5.x. TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) port and no longer exposes the CJS API surface the tooling reaches for: both svelte-check and ESLint crash outright with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading useCaseSensitiveFileNames)', verified locally, not merely a peer-range warning.
typescript-eslint 8.65.0 (its latest) still declares peer typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0'.
Remove this rule once typescript-eslint and svelte-check ship TypeScript 7 support; the pin in spa/package.json carries the same note.
